title: Hong Kong Drama 'We Are Born Good' Wins Top Golden Horse Prize
summaryZh: 港片《善男信女》奪金馬獎最佳劇情片。
summaryHi: हांगकांग की फ़िल्म 'We Are Born Good' ने गोल्डन हॉर्स अवॉर्ड्स में सर्वश्रेष्ठ फ़िल्म का पुरस्कार जीता।
summaryEs: El drama hongkonés 'We Are Born Good' gana el máximo premio de los Golden Horse.
summaryJa: 香港映画「善男信女」が金馬奨の最優秀作品賞に。
summaryKo: 홍콩 영화 '선남신녀', 금마장 최우수 극영화상 수상.
summaryEn: Yeung Leung-chuen's Hong Kong drama won Best Narrative Feature at Taipei's 63rd Golden Horse Awards, while Shu Qi was named Best New Director.
paragraphs: "We Are Born Good", a Hong Kong drama, claimed Best Narrative Feature at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards on Sunday, taking the most prestigious prize in Chinese-language cinema at a ceremony held at the Taipei Music Center.

Having entered the night with nine nominations, the film left with two trophies, also winning Best Original Screenplay, which director Yeung Leung-chuen shared with his co-writer. In the top category it beat a strong field that included "Girl", "Double Happiness", "Arrested Memory" and "We Are All Strangers".

Set in Hong Kong, the film follows a former prisoner trying to rebuild his life by running a cafe. After a young aspiring actress receives a botched food order, a minor dispute between the two gradually escalates into a bitter feud.

Accepting the award, Yeung said the trophy felt heavy but that he was able to lift it because everyone involved had been wonderful. He also urged the public to support cinemas, reminding them that films cannot survive without audiences.

Elsewhere, "Double Happiness" and "Kung Fu" each collected three awards, with Joseph Hsu named Best Director and Liu Kuan-ting Best Actor. Hong Kong's Angela Yuen won Best Actress, while Shu Qi took Best New Director for "Girl", a coming-of-age story set in Keelung in 1988.
The Golden Horse Awards are big film prizes for Chinese-language movies. This year's event was on Sunday night at the Taipei Music Center.
The top prize, Best Film, went to "We Are Born Good". It is a movie from Hong Kong. It also won the prize for the best story writing.

The movie is about a man who comes out of prison. He opens a small cafe and tries to start a new life. One day, a young woman who wants to be an actress gets the wrong food order. A small fight becomes a big, long fight.
The director, Yeung Leung-chuen, said the prize felt heavy. He asked people to go to the cinema, because films need people to watch them.
Other films also won. "Double Happiness" got three prizes, including Best Director and Best Actor. The famous actress Shu Qi won Best New Director for "Girl", the first film she directed.

paragraphs: The Hong Kong film "We Are Born Good" won the top prize at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards, the biggest awards for Chinese-language cinema, on Sunday night in Taipei.

The film had nine nominations and won two awards: Best Narrative Feature and Best Original Screenplay. The screenplay prize was shared by director Yeung Leung-chuen and his co-writer. It beat strong films such as "Girl", "Double Happiness" and "Arrested Memory".

The story takes place in Hong Kong. A former prisoner is trying to rebuild his life by running a cafe. When a young woman who dreams of acting receives a wrong food order, a small argument slowly turns into a bitter fight.
On stage, Yeung said the trophy felt heavy, but he could lift it because his team was wonderful. He also asked people to go to the cinema, saying films need audiences.

"Double Happiness" and "Kung Fu" won three awards each. Hong Kong actress Angela Yuen won Best Actress, and Shu Qi won Best New Director for "Girl", her first film as director, set in Keelung in 1988.

sentZh: 香港劇情片《善男信女》週日在第63屆金馬獎奪得最佳劇情長片，在台北流行音樂中心舉行的典禮上拿下華語電影最具聲望的獎項。
這部片帶著九項提名進場，最終抱走兩座獎座，另外還贏得最佳原著劇本，由導演楊兩全與共同編劇共享。
在最高獎項中，它擊敗了包括《女孩》、《雙囍》、《Arrested Memory》和《We Are All Strangers》在內的強勁對手。
這部以香港為背景的電影，講述一名前囚犯努力靠經營咖啡館重建人生。
在一位懷抱演員夢的年輕女子收到一份出錯的餐點後，兩人之間的小糾紛逐漸升級為激烈的宿怨。
楊兩全領獎時表示，獎座感覺很重，但因為所有參與的人都很出色，他才舉得起來。
他也呼籲大眾支持電影院，提醒大家電影沒有觀眾就無法生存。

香港的袁澧林贏得最佳女主角，舒淇則以《女孩》奪得最佳新導演，這是一部以1988年基隆為背景的成長故事。

paragraphs: Hong Kong drama "We Are Born Good" scooped Best Narrative Feature at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards on Sunday, securing the most coveted honour in Chinese-language film at a glittering ceremony in the Taipei Music Center.

The film arrived with nine nominations and converted two of them, adding Best Original Screenplay, a prize director Yeung Leung-chuen shared with his co-writer. In the headline category it prevailed over a formidable line-up, including "Girl", "Double Happiness", "Arrested Memory" and "We Are All Strangers".

The story centres on an ex-convict striving to rebuild his life as the owner of a modest cafe. When a young would-be actress is served a botched order, a trivial quarrel spirals into an increasingly bitter feud, exposing the pride and resentment simmering beneath everyday life.

Clutching the trophy, Yeung remarked that it felt heavy, yet he could raise it thanks to the brilliance of his collaborators. He then made a heartfelt appeal to viewers to return to cinemas, stressing that films depend on audiences to survive.

"Double Happiness" and "Kung Fu" shared the evening's highest tally with three awards apiece, earning Joseph Hsu Best Director and Liu Kuan-ting Best Actor. Angela Yuen won Best Actress, extending a run of non-Taiwanese winners to three years, while Shu Qi claimed Best New Director for her 1988 Keelung coming-of-age drama "Girl".
sentZh: 香港劇情片《善男信女》週日在第63屆金馬獎摘下最佳劇情長片，在台北流行音樂中心星光熠熠的典禮上奪得華語電影最令人夢寐以求的榮譽。
這部片帶著九項提名而來，其中兩項開花結果，另外拿下由導演楊兩全與共同編劇共享的最佳原著劇本獎。
在最受矚目的獎項中，它勝過了包括《女孩》、《雙囍》、《Arrested Memory》和《We Are All Strangers》在內的強大陣容。
故事圍繞一名出獄者，他努力以一家小咖啡館老闆的身分重建人生。
當一位想當演員的年輕女子拿到一份出錯的餐點時，一場微不足道的口角急遽演變成越來越激烈的宿怨，揭露了潛藏在日常生活底下的自尊與怨恨。
楊兩全緊握獎座說，它感覺很重，但多虧合作夥伴的才華，他才能把它舉起來。
接著他衷心呼籲觀眾重回電影院，強調電影要靠觀眾才能生存。
《雙囍》和《Kung Fu》以各三座獎並列當晚最多，讓許承傑獲得最佳導演、劉冠廷獲得最佳男主角。
袁澧林贏得最佳女主角，使非台灣籍得主的連續紀錄延長到三年；舒淇則以設定在1988年基隆的成長劇情片《女孩》奪得最佳新導演。

paragraphs: The Hong Kong drama "We Are Born Good" was named Best Narrative Feature at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards on Sunday, receiving the most prestigious accolade in Chinese-language cinema at a ceremony staged at the Taipei Music Center.

Having secured nine nominations, the film ultimately won two awards, including Best Original Screenplay, which director Yeung Leung-chuen shared with his co-writer. In the principal category, it triumphed over a highly competitive selection of contenders, notably "Girl", "Double Happiness", "Arrested Memory" and "We Are All Strangers".

The narrative revolves around a former inmate attempting to rebuild his life by operating a small cafe. When an aspiring young actress receives an incorrect food order, a seemingly insignificant disagreement gradually escalates into a protracted and bitter conflict.

In his acceptance speech, Yeung observed that the trophy felt heavy, although he was able to lift it owing to the exceptional contributions of his team. He also encouraged the public to attend cinemas, emphasising that the film industry relies fundamentally on audiences.

Among the other winners, "Double Happiness" and "Kung Fu" each received three awards, with Joseph Hsu recognised as Best Director and Liu Kuan-ting as Best Actor. Angela Yuen was named Best Actress, and Shu Qi won Best New Director for "Girl", a coming-of-age film set in Keelung in 1988.
sentZh: 香港劇情片《善男信女》週日在第63屆金馬獎被評為最佳劇情長片，在台北流行音樂中心舉辦的典禮上獲得華語電影最具聲望的殊榮。
這部片在獲得九項提名後，最終贏得兩個獎項，包括由導演楊兩全與共同編劇共享的最佳原著劇本。
在主要獎項中，它戰勝了一批競爭激烈的候選作品，尤其是《女孩》、《雙囍》、《Arrested Memory》和《We Are All Strangers》。
故事圍繞一名前受刑人，他試圖藉由經營一家小咖啡館重建人生。
當一位懷抱演員夢的年輕女子收到錯誤的餐點時，一場看似微不足道的意見不合逐漸升級為一場曠日持久的激烈衝突。
楊兩全在得獎感言中表示，獎座感覺很重，但由於團隊的傑出貢獻，他才能舉起它。
他也鼓勵大眾到電影院看電影，強調電影產業從根本上依賴觀眾。
在其他得獎者中，《雙囍》和《Kung Fu》各獲得三個獎項，許承傑獲評為最佳導演，劉冠廷獲評為最佳男主角。
袁澧林獲選最佳女主角，舒淇則以《女孩》贏得最佳新導演，這是一部以1988年基隆為背景的成長電影。

story.ex: She read a story to the children.

strangers.ex: We were strangers until we met at school.
